articles.summary: Teach the Agent how you work. Skills let legal teams encode their standards, processes and preferences inside the Legora aOS™.
articles.title: Why Skills make the best lawyers more valuable

articles.summary: Legora, the agentic operating system for legal work, and Conga, the company lining up commerce, announced an integration that brings contracts managed in Conga Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) directly into the Legora platform.
articles.title: Legora and Conga integrate to bring enterprise contracts into the agentic operating system for legal work

articles.summary: Fieldfisher is rolling out AI platform Legora to around 1,400 lawyers and Business Services professionals across its international offices following a six-week pilot with 137 users in Europe. The rollout is led from the firm’s AI hub at Fieldfisher X in Berlin, set up last year to deliver its global AI strategy.
articles.title: Fieldfisher goes firm-wide with Legora across its international network

articles.summary: Legora, the agentic operating system for legal professionals, announced that Obermayer Rebmann Maxwell & Hippel LLP (Obermayer), a full-service law firm headquartered in Philadelphia, has selected Legora as its legal AI platform.
articles.title: Obermayer adopts Legora to accelerate legal work and unlock firm knowledge
